Name: Shaalim
ModernLocation: Unknown; in the hill country near Shual
Description: The land of Shaalim was a district Saul passed through while searching for his father's lost donkeys, before he came to the land of Zuph and met Samuel.
BiblicalSignificance: Shaalim is one of the districts of Saul's fruitless search, the road that led him, unknowing, toward his anointing.
